reference_sample_article.headline: Federal Reserve Holds Interest Rates Steady Amid Mixed Economic Signals
reference_sample_article.body_text: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged on Wednesday, citing a combination of resilient employment figures and persistent inflation pressures that have complicated the central bank's policy outlook. Officials noted that consumer spending has moderated in recent months, while manufacturing output remained roughly flat compared with the previous quarter. In a statement following the two-day meeting, the committee said it would continue to monitor incoming data before making further adjustments to borrowing costs. Economists surveyed ahead of the decision had largely anticipated the pause, pointing to uncertainty around trade policy and its potential effect on supply chains. Several analysts cautioned that a premature rate cut could reignite inflationary pressure, while others warned that prolonged restrictive policy risks slowing hiring further. The central bank's next scheduled meeting will take place in six weeks, and officials indicated that any future decisions would remain dependent on labor market and inflation data released between now and then.
